script.title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Devastator Intercept
script.description: A sweeping armored dagger with a deep equatorial machinery trench, eight twin-barrel batteries, seven horizontal engines, terraced command decks and twin faceted shield generators. A captured miniature blockade runner waits beneath the open ventral hangar. The hollow hull rests on a compact black display cradle.
